en-US.author: NetEase Youdao Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
en-US.description: A 24/7 personal assistant Agent that gets things done
en-US.longDescription:
LobsterAI is an all-in-one personal assistant Agent developed by NetEase Youdao. It works around the clock to handle your everyday tasks — data analysis, making presentations, generating videos, writing documents, searching the web, sending emails, scheduling tasks, and more.
At its core is Cowork mode — it executes tools, manipulates files, and runs commands in a local or sandboxed environment, all under your supervision. You can also chat with agent via Telegram, Discord, DingTalk or Feishu (Lark) and get work done from your phone anytime, anywhere.
Key Features
- All-in-One Productivity Assistant — Data analysis, PPT creation, video generation, document writing, web search, email — covers the full range of daily work
- Local + Sandbox Execution — Run tasks directly on your machine or in an isolated Alpine Linux sandbox
- Built-in Skills — Office document generation, web search, Playwright automation, Remotion video generation, and more
- Windows Built-in Python Runtime — Windows packages bundle a ready-to-use Python interpreter runtime; Python skill dependencies can be installed on demand
- Scheduled Tasks — Create recurring tasks via conversation or the GUI — daily news digests, inbox cleanup, periodic report generation, and more
- Persistent Memory — Automatically extracts user preferences and personal facts from conversations, remembers your habits across sessions, and gets smarter the more you use it
- Mobile via IM — Control your Agent remotely from your phone through Telegram, Discord, DingTalk, or Feishu
- Permission Gating — All tool invocations require explicit user approval before execution
- Cross-Platform — macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon), Windows, Linux desktop, plus mobile coverage via IM
- Local Data — SQLite storage keeps your chat history and configuration on your device

zh-CN.author: 网易有道信息技术（北京）有限公司
zh-CN.description: 一个 7×24 小时帮你干活的全场景个人助理 Agent
zh-CN.longDescription:
LobsterAI 是由网易有道开发的全场景个人助理 Agent。它 7×24 小时待命，能够帮你完成日常办公中的各类事务 —— 数据分析、制作 PPT、生成视频、撰写文档、搜索信息、收发邮件、定时任务，以及更多。
LobsterAI 的核心是 Cowork 模式，它能在本地或沙箱环境中执行工具、操作文件、运行命令，一切都在你的监督下自主完成。此外，LobsterAI 支持通过钉钉、飞书、Telegram、Discord 等 IM 平台远程触发，让你在手机上也能随时指挥 Agent 工作。
核心特性
- 全场景办公助理 — 数据分析、PPT 制作、视频生成、文档撰写、Web 搜索、邮件收发，覆盖日常办公全流程
- 本地 + 沙箱执行 — 任务执行支持本地直接运行或隔离的 Alpine Linux 沙箱
- 内置技能 — 包括 Office 文档生成、Web 搜索、Playwright 自动化、Remotion 视频生成等
- Windows 内置 Python 运行时 — Windows 安装包内置可直接使用的 Python 解释器运行时；Python 技能依赖可按需安装
- 定时任务 — 支持对话式发起或 GUI 界面添加定时任务，如每日新闻收集、邮箱整理、周期性报告生成等
- 持久记忆 — 自动从对话中提取用户偏好与个人信息，跨会话记住你的习惯，越用越懂你
- IM 远程操控 — 通过钉钉、飞书、Telegram、Discord 在手机端随时触发 Agent
- 权限门控 — 所有敏感工具调用需用户明确批准后执行
- 跨平台 — macOS（Intel + Apple Silicon）、Windows、Linux 桌面端，配合 IM 实现移动端覆盖
- 数据本地化 — SQLite 本地存储，聊天记录和配置不离开你的设备
zh-CN.name: LobsterAI
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
2026.11.2
A release focused on reliability: chat streams now survive mid-reply drops, oversized contexts recover with visible compaction progress, the image pipeline is cheaper and less chatty, and installers ship a lot less dead weight.
Highlights
1. Model streams reconnect automatically when they drop mid-reply instead of leaving the message truncated (#2974).
2. Oversized conversations now recover instead of failing, with compaction progress surfaced in the UI (#2982, #3014, #2988).
3. One image confirmation can now approve the rest of a turn's images, and delivery recovery is more robust (#2995, #2980, #2994).
4. Installer and runtime bundles are significantly slimmer: no source maps, no tsc output, no debug-only files (#2976, #2985, #2996).
5. DeepSeek Harness runtime moved to 0.2.2-rc.1 with cleaner shutdown and leftover reclamation (#2989, #3007, #3008).
New Features
1. 
2. Desktop companion: selection requests continue after sign-in instead of being dropped (#3005).
3. Sidebar: login benefits now shown in a promo bubble (#3015).
4. Release: added the codown SVN publish workflow (#2966).
5. DSH: bumped DeepSeek Harness runtime to 0.2.1-rc.5, then 0.2.2-rc.1 with bundled pnpm plugin installs (#2989, #3007).
Performance
1. OpenClaw ships only allowlisted bundled skills (#2996).
2. Windows process start times are read natively (#2997).
3. Windows registry roots and code page are read natively (#3002).
4. Gateway client connects sooner after startup (#3000).
5. The dreaming startup scrub is skipped when dreaming is off (#3001).
6. build-info.json ships beside the gateway bundle instead of being generated at runtime (#3011).
7. Media intent recovery no longer blocks the main thread (#2965).
8. Memory search no longer launches a second app instance (#3013).
Bug Fixes
Chat and Cowork
1. Restored truncated chat.history replies and fixed composer popover clipping (#2981).
2. Model selection is preserved in scheduled-task conversations (#2986).
3. Generated images are no longer stored inline in message metadata (#2999).
4. Images are kept when copying a user message (#3009).
5. macOS image thumbnails are requested in points so QuickLook stops returning the file icon (#3017).
Media
1. Image confirmation is preserved and image delivery recovers after interruptions (#2980).
2. Visible subagents can generate images again (#2994).
Desktop Companion
1. The orb stays under the pointer while dragging (#2979).
2. Selections the hook skips are now shown over the pointer shape and in AppKit apps (#2984, #2992).
3. Task card stays above full-screen apps, and hidden surfaces no longer jump on open (#3003).
4. Reopened panels get key focus back on macOS (#3006).
5. Unintended selection answer cancellation is prevented (#3016).
OpenClaw Runtime
1. sessions_spawn children stay off model-picked models (#2975).
2. Windows plugins load natively, and plugin realpaths are cached (#2987).
3. Byte-bounded history is compacted instead of slid (#2988).
4. Integrity checks are skipped for cleanly closed agent databases (#2990).
5. Install paths are re-rendered in the no-model config sync (#3010).
6. Sign-out config shrink is applied without a gateway restart (#3012).
Packaging and Build
1. Source maps, tsc output and unused runtime files are no longer shipped (#2976).
2. Bundled and debug-only files are excluded from the installer (#2985).
Web Search
1. Bundled dist stays usable after copying, and npm repairs that cannot work are no longer attempted (#2977).
2. Node runs without the env found on PATH (#2983).
DSH
1. Plugins install with bundled pnpm (#3007).
2. The runtime stops on quit and leftovers are reclaimed on restart (#3008).
Account
1. Account menu opens without waiting on the daily check-in (#2991).
CI and Docs
1. Dependabot no longer opens unmergeable dependency PRs (#2978).
2. Documented stacked post-ready measurement for the registry/code page patch (#3004).
Contributors
Thanks to @fisherdaddy, @btc69m979y-dotcom, @Mind-Hand and @liuzhq1986 for this release.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/netease-youdata/LobsterAI/compare/2026.10.30...2026.11.6
